concept: Thinking Person with Hand at Chin
description: A round headed person raises one hand against the lower edge of the face. The bent arm curves down to the right beside a partially outlined torso with rounded shoulders.

concept: Plain Dreidel with Central Stroke
description: A dreidel has a square body, a short rounded handle above, and a tapered triangular point below. One upright stroke marks the otherwise blank front face above the lower dividing seam.

concept: Upright Dock with Broad Rounded Base
description: A docking stand has a broad low base with rounded ends and a tall central upright. The upright rises with parallel sides to a rounded top, leaving equal shoulders on either side.

concept: Single Upright Indicator Line
description: A single straight vertical line stands alone against an empty background. Its uninterrupted stem extends from the top to the bottom without any crossbars, attached shapes, or directional head.

concept: Cane User Beside Seated Guide Dog
description: A walking person holds a long cane angled toward the lower right while a dog sits beside the trailing leg. The figure has a round head and one forward stepping leg.

concept: Cream Dollop with Tall Curled Peak
description: A dollop of cream rises from a broad rounded base into uneven stacked curves. Its narrow top curls into a sharp peak, with a smaller shoulder projecting on the right.

concept: Whistle Sounding Beside Dog Profile
description: A rounded whistle angles toward the upper right with three short sound rays beyond its mouthpiece. A small dog head profile faces it from the lower right, showing a rounded muzzle.

concept: Bib Overalls with Rounded Chest Pocket
description: A pair of overalls has two upright shoulder straps above a broad bib and curved arm openings. A small rounded chest pocket sits centrally above two short legs separated by a narrow gap.

concept: Flying Bird Carrying Taped Parcel
description: A bird flies toward the right with one raised pointed wing and a broad tail extending left. A tilted rectangular parcel hangs beneath its body, marked with a short folded tape strip.

concept: Chicken Drumstick with Bitten Upper Edge
description: A chicken drumstick slopes from a small rounded bone end at the lower left toward a broad meaty upper end. Several concave bite marks interrupt the edge at the upper right.

concept: Classical Building with Three Columns
description: A classical building faces forward beneath a triangular pediment and broad horizontal entablature. Three tall narrow columns support the roof above a raised rectangular base, leaving open spaces between them.

concept: Rounded Rain Cloud with Slanted Streaks
description: A cloud has three rounded upper lobes and a flat lower edge. Three separate slanted rain streaks descend beneath it, with the middle streak extending farther down than the outer two.

concept: Wavy Earthworm with Rounded Ends
description: A thick earthworm bends through two opposing curves across the view. Its left end turns downward into a rounded tip, while the right end rises and bends outward into a broader rounded head.

concept: Deer Head with Branching Antlers
description: A deer head faces right with a long rounded muzzle and one pointed ear extending left. Tall branching antlers rise above the forehead, while two neck edges descend below the head.

concept: Round Lens on Short Pedestal
description: A large circular lens housing sits on a short upright pedestal with rounded lower corners. A smaller centered circle forms the opening within the otherwise blank round front surface.

concept: Paired Table Columns with Copy Arrows
description: Two tall rectangular columns stand side by side, each divided into three equal cells. Two small right pointing arrows occupy the gap between them, aligned with the upper and lower cell boundaries.

concept: Ear with Two Outward Sound Waves
description: An ear outline curves around a folded inner contour and narrows into a rounded lower lobe. Two separate curved sound waves sit to its right, increasing in height toward the outside.

concept: Person Sheltering Beneath Shaking Table
description: A person crouches low beneath a broad table, with bent limbs tucked inside the space between its legs. Two short jagged vibration lines hover above the tabletop on opposite sides.

concept: Paintbrush Across Decorated Easter Egg
description: A large egg carries a wavy decoration line across its upper half. A paintbrush lies diagonally over the right side, with its broad curved bristles resting near the egg's lower center.

concept: Easter Egg Wrapped with Ribbon Bow
description: An upright egg is wrapped by a horizontal ribbon band across its middle. A large bow sits toward the upper right, with two rounded loops, a central knot, and notched hanging tails.

concept: Compact Motor with Opposing Shafts
description: A compact motor has a rounded rectangular casing with a horizontal seam near the top. Short shafts project from the top and bottom, while two curved marks sit on its front face.

concept: Smiling Face Hugging Blank Phone
description: A round smiling face has closed curved eyes above a small curved mouth. One arm wraps around a tilted rectangular phone on the left, with a rounded hand overlapping its lower edge.

concept: Octagonal Gem with Inset Facet Ring
description: An octagonal gemstone surrounds a smaller central octagon with a ring of sloping facets. Straight lines connect corresponding corners, producing a balanced arrangement of trapezoidal side faces around the blank center.

concept: Front View Car with Round Headlights
description: A car faces forward with a wide rounded body beneath a tapered windshield. Two circular headlights sit apart on the front, and two short rounded tires project below the lower corners.

concept: Drink Glass with Bent Straw
description: A tall drinking glass narrows toward a rounded bottom and contains a gently wavy liquid surface. A thin straw rises from the drink, bends near the top, and extends right.

concept: Hand Lowering Upright Ballot into Box
description: A hand enters from the upper right and grips an upright rectangular ballot between finger and thumb. The ballot descends behind the broad rounded lid of a plain rectangular ballot box.

concept: Hand Lowering Diagonal Ballot Toward Slot
description: A hand reaches diagonally down from the upper right to hold a tilted rectangular ballot. The ballot's bottom corner touches a short horizontal slot line beneath the hand and paper.

concept: Hand Gripping Upward Tilted Megaphone
description: A hand wraps around the handle of a megaphone angled toward the upper right. Its rounded rear housing opens into a broad flared horn, with finger divisions visible across the grip.

concept: Hand Inserting Tilted Ballot into Box
description: A hand reaches from the upper right to hold a rectangular ballot at a diagonal. The paper's lower corner meets the broad rounded top of a plain rectangular voting box.

concept: Cordless Drill with Short Bit
description: A handheld drill points left with a short straight bit projecting from its rounded horizontal housing. A trigger sits inside the handle area above a broad rectangular battery base.

concept: Hair Dryer Blowing Three Warm Air Waves
description: A hair dryer points right with a broad straight nozzle and rounded rear housing containing a circular vent. A handle slopes downward beneath it, while three wavy air lines extend beyond the nozzle.

concept: Smiling Face Holding Pizza Slice
description: A smiling round face has closed curved eyes and an upturned mouth. A rounded hand lifts a triangular pizza slice across the lower face, with a curved crust band along its base.

concept: Smiling Face Holding Open Book
description: A round smiling face looks over an open book with two spread pages and a central fold. One rounded hand curls around the right page beneath closed curved eyes and a smiling mouth.

concept: House with Driveway Widening Forward
description: A simple house has a peaked roof and a broad rectangular doorway with rounded upper corners. Two lines extend from the doorway's lower edges and spread outward toward the foreground.

concept: Bench Drill Press with Side Column
description: A drill press has a broad rounded upper housing, a hanging chuck, and a slender vertical drill bit. A sturdy right column curves into the base beneath a small projecting worktable.

concept: Rounded Server Connected to Hexagonal Hub
description: A rounded horizontal server unit has a circular indicator at the left and a long slot beside it. A short stem links it to a hexagonal hub with three outward connection lines.

concept: Long Eel in Broad Double Bend
description: An eel faces left with a small eye on its broad rounded head. Its long body bends right, turns back left through another curve, and ends in a thick rounded lower tail.

concept: Waisted Mannequin Torso Form
description: A headless mannequin torso has a short rounded neck stump above sloping shoulders. Its sides narrow at the waist and widen again toward a broad flat base with rounded lower corners.

concept: Diagonal Capsule with Center Seam
description: An elongated capsule lies diagonally from lower left to upper right with matching rounded ends. A straight crosswise seam divides the body into two plain halves near the middle.

concept: Rounded Caplet with Flat Lower End
description: A broad caplet tilts diagonally toward the upper right, with a fully rounded upper end and a flatter lower edge. Its plain body has straight sides and softened lower corners.

concept: Eagle Profile with Hooked Beak
description: An eagle faces right with a domed head and a large hooked beak. A sweeping inner line defines a broad folded wing, while the lower chest curves down beside it.

concept: Uneven Earth Mound with Curved Marks
description: A mound of earth has a tall rounded central peak and two lower shoulders above a flat base. Short curved marks trace smaller bumps across the otherwise blank front surface.

concept: Cylindrical Drum with Triangular Lacing
description: A cylindrical drum has an elliptical top and curved horizontal bands near its upper and lower edges. Two diagonal lacing lines descend from the upper band to meet in a central downward point.

concept: Broad Headphones with Tall Rounded Earcups
description: A smooth arched headband joins two tall rounded earcups hanging on either side. The cups face inward toward a wide open center, with their inner edges descending nearly straight.

concept: Drummer Holding Two Sticks Above Drum
description: A round headed drummer sits behind a small cylindrical drum with an elliptical top. Two sticks angle upward beside the shoulders, with one round hand visible on the right.

concept: Person Reaching Toward Vending Machine
description: A standing person extends an arm toward a tall rounded vending machine. Four square product windows appear above a broad rectangular delivery opening, with the figure partly overlapping the machine's left edge.

concept: Person Raising Megaphone with Sound Rays
description: A small round headed figure raises one arm toward a large upward tilted megaphone. The horn flares to the upper right, with three straight sound rays spreading beyond its mouth.

concept: Driver Bust Behind Circular Steering Wheel
description: A round headed person faces forward behind a circular steering wheel overlapping the lower torso. A horizontal spoke and central hub join a short lower spoke inside the wheel.

concept: Arrow Broad Right with Square Tail
description: A broad outlined arrow points directly right, with a long rectangular shaft and a triangular head. The shaft begins at a flat vertical tail and joins the head through two square shoulders.

concept: Rounded Rubber Duck Facing Left
description: A rubber duck faces left with a small projecting bill, a dot eye, and a rounded head. Its plump body curves toward an upturned tail on the right above a broad base.

concept: Tapered Earplug with Narrow Stem
description: An earplug lies diagonally from lower left to upper right, with a narrow rounded stem beneath a wider tapered body. The broad cap curves into a rounded tip and flares at its lower edge.

concept: Short Sleeved Dress with Flared Skirt
description: A dress has short outward sleeves, a wide round neckline, and a narrow waist. Its plain skirt widens toward a gently curved hem, creating a balanced front facing silhouette.

concept: Compact Side View Car with Plain Cabin
description: A compact car has a rounded rectangular lower body and two circular wheels. A raised cabin with curved upper corners slopes down at the right, separated from the body by a horizontal line.

concept: House with Wide Eaves and Rounded Door
description: A front facing house has a broad triangular roof extending beyond both side walls. A small centered doorway with rounded upper corners reaches the flat base between softly rounded lower wall corners.

concept: Eel with Narrow Raised Tail
description: A thick eel bends from a broad left facing head through an S shaped body. Its lower section sweeps right into a narrow upturned tail ending at a pointed tip.

concept: Oval Headed Bust with Open Neck Gap
description: A tall oval head floats above broad curved shoulders, leaving a small gap at the neck. The torso extends downward into a wide flat base with rounded lower corners.

concept: Single Drumstick with Bulbous Tip
description: A long drumstick lies diagonally from lower left to upper right. Its narrow shaft ends in a rounded handle above, while the lower end swells into a smooth bulbous striking tip.

concept: Small Bird with Short Angular Legs
description: A small bird faces left with a pointed beak and tiny dot eye. A curved line marks its folded wing above a plump body, supported by two short angular legs.

concept: Side Table with Lower Crossbar
description: A small table has a thick rounded top above a horizontal apron and two upright legs. A lower crossbar spans between the legs, whose ends curve into soft rounded feet.

concept: Suspended Service Lift with Divided Cabin
description: A compact service lift has a rounded rectangular cabin divided horizontally through its middle. A short vertical cable rises from its top through a small circular pulley and continues upward.

concept: Smiling Elf with Drooping Bobble Hat
description: An elf face has pointed ears spreading sideways beneath a drooping pointed hat with a round bobble. Two short upright eyes and a small curved smile mark the rounded face.

concept: Smiling Face Hugging Ribboned Gift
description: A smiling circular face wraps one rounded arm around a tilted gift box. Crossing ribbon bands divide the box, with two rounded bow loops above and closed curved eyes on the face.

concept: Smiling Face Behind Game Controller
description: A round smiling face sits behind a broad game controller with two downward grips. Closed curved eyes and an upturned mouth appear above the controller, which carries a small cross shaped control.

concept: Closed Eye Face Holding Heart
description: A large round face has two closed curved eyes above a heart held close to its lower half. Two rounded hands overlap the heart's lower sides, leaving its lobes visible above.

concept: Smiling Face with Two Open Hands
description: A smiling face appears above two large open hands angled inward toward each other. Curved closed eyes sit above the mouth, while the circular head outline stops above the raised palms.

concept: Speaker Horn with Three Sound Arcs
description: A speaker has a rounded rear block joined to a flared horn pointing right. Three separate curved sound arcs spread outward beyond the horn, increasing in height with distance.

concept: Two Stacked Planes Beneath Round Node
description: Two broad diamond shaped planes overlap vertically, with the upper plane obscuring the center of the lower one. A round node touches the upper plane's rear corner at the top.

concept: Dynamite Stick with Starburst Fuse
description: A rounded rectangular stick of dynamite tilts toward the upper right. A short fuse extends from its upper end to an irregular pointed starburst, separated from the main body.

concept: Open Ear Outline with Short Inner Curve
description: A broad outer ear curve arches over the top and descends toward the lower left, remaining open on the right. A smaller curved fold sits inside its upper portion.

concept: Perspective Sugar Cube Above Spoon
description: A single sugar cube appears above a spoon, showing its square front and two angled side faces. The spoon below has a deep rounded bowl and a long horizontal handle extending right.

concept: Three Sugar Cubes Above Deep Spoon
description: Three small rounded sugar cubes form a stack above a deep spoon, with one cube resting on two below. The spoon's long straight handle extends to the right from its oval bowl.

concept: Cloud Raining Three Hearts
description: A rounded cloud opens along its lower edge around a central heart. Two more hearts fall beneath its outer sides, forming a triangular arrangement of heart shaped drops below the cloud.

concept: Overlapping Tragedy and Comedy Masks
description: Two theatrical masks overlap at an angle, with the frowning mask in front on the left. Curved closed eyes appear on both faces, while the rear mask carries a broad smile.

concept: Corn Cob Emerging from Two Husk Leaves
description: An upright corn cob rises as a long rounded oval between two pointed husk leaves. The leaves curve outward and meet at the base around a short central stem.

concept: Cow Face with Curved Horns and Broad Muzzle
description: A cow faces forward with two curved horns and sideways ears above a broad head. Tiny eyes sit over a large rounded muzzle containing two small nostril marks.

concept: Diagonal Sword with Straight Crossguard
description: A sword angles upward to the right with a broad pointed blade and a long inner ridge line. A straight crossguard separates the blade from a short rounded handle below.

concept: Dining Table Between Two Chairs with Bowl
description: A small dining table stands between two chairs facing inward from opposite sides. A shallow oval bowl rests centrally on the tabletop, above the straight legs and narrow chair seats.

concept: Curved Macaroni Tube with Open Ends
description: A short macaroni tube forms a broad U shaped bend with unevenly raised ends. Oval openings at both tips reveal its hollow interior, while smooth inner and outer curves define the tube.

concept: Fireplace with Central Flame and Broad Mantel
description: A fireplace has a broad horizontal mantel supported above a rounded rectangular fire opening. A pointed flame rises centrally from the hearth, with a smaller inner flame inside its base.

concept: Burning Barrel with Tall Flame
description: A straight sided barrel has several horizontal bands across its body and projecting rim lines. A large flame with three uneven points rises from the open top above the barrel.

concept: Three Panel Map with Zigzag Edges
description: An unfolded map has three tall panels joined by two upright crease lines. Its upper and lower edges rise and fall across the folds, creating a continuous zigzag sheet in perspective.

concept: Macaron with Thick Central Filling
description: A round macaron is seen from the side with two broad domed shells. A thick horizontal filling band separates the upper and lower halves, following their softly rounded ends.

concept: Meat Steak with Rounded Bone Center
description: An irregular steak has a broad rounded left side tapering toward a narrower right end. A small rounded bone shape sits inside the upper left, with a curved side edge below.

concept: Raised Hand Beside Curved Motion Lines
description: An upright open hand has four close fingers and a thumb angled outward to the left. Two curved motion lines sit beside the thumb, separated from the hand's outer contour.

concept: Key with Heart Shaped Bow Opening
description: A key tilts upward to the right from a round bow containing a heart shaped opening. Its long rounded shaft extends diagonally, with two small detached tooth marks beside the outer edge.

concept: Arrow Horizontal with Two Open Heads
description: A long horizontal shaft ends in matching open arrowheads pointing left and right. Each head has two diagonal arms meeting at the shaft endpoint, creating a balanced double ended pointer.

concept: Horse Head with Arched Neck
description: A horse head faces left with a long sloping muzzle and a small pointed ear. The neck arches broadly down on the right, while an inner curve defines the jaw and throat.

concept: Judge Gavel Above Small Sound Block
description: A judge's gavel lies diagonally with a broad cylindrical head between two thick end caps. Its long rounded handle extends down left, while a small rounded sound block sits separately below.

concept: Tapered Lighthouse with Four Light Rays
description: A lighthouse has a tall tapered tower below a projecting gallery and a small roofed lantern room. Two straight light rays extend from each side above a short horizontal ground line.

concept: Lipstick Beside Round Powder Compact
description: An upright lipstick has an angled exposed tip above a stepped cylindrical tube. A round powder compact stands beside it, divided horizontally across its center into two plain halves.

concept: Soap Bottle with Tall Pump Stem
description: A rounded rectangular soap bottle has a narrow collar and a tall central pump stem. A horizontal dispenser head spreads above the stem, curving down slightly at both outer ends.

concept: Lynx Face with Pointed Ears and Whiskers
description: A lynx faces forward with tall pointed ears above a rounded head. Narrow eyes flank a long angular nose, with paired whisker lines and a divided curved mouth below.

concept: Magic Wand with Five Pointed Star
description: A long thin wand rises diagonally from the lower left into a large five pointed star. The star's uneven angular points spread around the end of the otherwise plain straight shaft.

concept: Makeup Brush Beside Six Well Palette
description: A broad makeup brush stands beside a rounded rectangular palette containing six square wells in two columns. The brush's rounded bristle head narrows into a straight handle with a rounded bottom.

concept: Masked Person with Frowning Mouth
description: A front facing person wears a broad eye mask with narrow horizontal eye slits and a raised nose bridge. A small frown sits below the mask above a short neck and rounded shoulders.

concept: Round Mandarin with Small Left Leaf
description: A round mandarin hangs beneath a short upright stem that curves toward the upper right. One pointed leaf extends to the upper left, joining the stem above the fruit's plain surface.

concept: Mangrove with Exposed Roots in Water
description: A mangrove tree has a three lobed crown above a straight trunk and two diagonal branches. Exposed curved roots spread into two wavy waterlines beneath the tree on either side.

concept: Location Pin with Small Round Center
description: A teardrop location marker has a broad rounded head tapering into a sharp lower point. A small circular opening sits high inside the head, surrounded by a wide blank border.

concept: Location Pin with Broad Round Center
description: A location marker curves around a large circular opening before narrowing toward a sharp bottom point. Its broad upper head and long tapered sides form a balanced upright teardrop silhouette.

concept: Pointed Maple Leaf with Central Vein
description: A maple leaf spreads into several sharply pointed lobes around a tall central tip. Deep angular notches separate the lobes, and a straight central vein continues downward into the stem.
